name: slurmless
description: Slurm-free SmartSlurm test harness, plus a Migration Assistant skill that converts hand-rolled SLURM workflows or loose scripts to SmartSlurm's runAsPipeline and proves them off-cluster in the sandbox.

smartslurm_path.title: SmartSlurm checkout
smartslurm_path.description: Absolute path to a SmartSlurm clone (the one whose bin/runAsPipeline the harness runs). Optional: if left blank, the harness auto-resolves a vendored or sibling checkout, or clones upstream master on first bootstrap.
